title: Khung kết quả học tập và tiêu chí đạt

policy.retestPolicy: A later attempt may update mastery; retain attempt history.
policy.scopeWarning: Across all 33 criteria, Foundation retains 6/6 criterion-level local evidence paths. The TOEIC objectives now have explicit stable-question mappings for 25/27 sub-skill criteria; two criteria remain defined but deliberately uninstrumented until stronger item-level evidence or a suitable assessment design exists. Evidence is stored learner-locally under the existing objectiveProgress record without an IndexedDB schema migration. The map covers 1,148 criterion/question links across 648 unique stable question IDs; links are inventory coverage, not learner mastery. Every criterion still requires at least its declared minimum of unique observed items and its declared threshold. Optional Grammar and Reading Part 5 explanation rubrics are learner self-reports. Separate Part 5 timed_accuracy uses a 30-second internal practice target only. Listening reserve remains excluded; Reading Part 7 and Separate Part 5 editorial gates remain active. No CEFR/ETS certification is implied.

runtimeWiring.limitations: Production rubric and recall remain learner-local/self-reported; no external CEFR/ETS certification.
